notes.title: Ghost Hand Demo presentation
notes.notes:
Soar through the skies on the back of a winged beast. Explore the depths of a painstakingly rendered world.

encountering new gear to customize your play style and craft Iria's look to your vision.

Ghost Hand is a Soviet inspired fantasy Metroidvania. Immerse yourself in a vast, atmospheric fantasy world, brimming with secrets to uncover and a story that would make any JRPG proud.

The game features a art style that blends seamlessly the oil pain pixel art aesthetics of Owlboy in a 2.5D environment similar to Klonoa, in a world with Exploration and Character customization inspired by the likes of Symphony of the Night with Ori inspired Bosses, while having the capability of mounting a Dragon and toasting your enemies like you would Drakengard.
